title: Some Remarks on the Spectral Geometry of the Gribov Horizon
summary: We develop a local spectral framework for the Landau-gauge Gribov horizon that distinguishes gauge-orbit projection from degeneracy of the gauge-fixing Hessian. On a flat torus, spatially constant ghosts form a residual global-color kernel; after removal of this kernel, the reduced Faddeev-Popov operator is the normal Morse-Bott Hessian of the orbit-norm functional, whereas the covariant Laplacian defines the orthogonal connection.
